description: This source file is a Java class that implements data access methods for 'Observation' (Obs) entities in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It uses Hibernate ORM to interact with the database, providing CRUD operations, query mechanisms, and criteria-based searches for observation records.

classes.name: HibernateObsDAO
classes.description: A Hibernate-specific implementation of the ObsDAO interface, providing database operations for Obs entities, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and specialized queries involving filters and criteria.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory to enable database connections.

methods.name: deleteObs
methods.description: Deletes an observation record from the database.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an observation by its ID.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves or updates an Obs object in the database, including its group members if present.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Obs based on various optional filters such as person, encounter, concept questions/answers, location, date range, visits, grouping, pagination, and ordering.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Counts the number of observations matching specified filters.

methods.name: createGetObservationsCriteria
methods.description: Builds a list of query predicates based on provided filter parameters for flexible observation searching.

methods.name: createOrderList
methods.description: Creates a list of orderings for query results based on sort instructions.

methods.name: getCriteriaPersonModifier
methods.description: Adds criteria to filter by person types such as patient or user.

methods.name: getObsByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an Obs record by UUID.

methods.name: getRevisionObs
methods.description: Retrieves the previous version of a given Obs, if any.

methods.name: getSavedStatus
methods.description: Fetches the save status of an Obs record from the database.
